import sys,json,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'armport/replay')
import run_ci,compare_state
root=Path('/tmp/coh-resume/arm64-40247679017')
report=json.loads((root/'report.json').read_text())
assert report['source_commit']=='4c8b6c3903187a187028bb708e0f22159cc8496a'
assert report['target']=='arm64' and report['cursor_stage_passed'] is True
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as t: expected=run_ci.fixtures(Path(t))
for label,id in [('id1-a',1),('id1-b',1),('id31',31)]:
 p=root/label;proc=json.loads((p/'process-observation.json').read_text())
 assert proc['returncode']==2 and not proc.get('host_timeout_kill',False)
 run_ci.check_output(p/'receiver.jsonl',expected,id,p/'wine-output.txt',original_texture_exception=True)
assert all((root/'id1-a'/f'state-{i:03d}.json').read_bytes()==(root/'id1-b'/f'state-{i:03d}.json').read_bytes() for i in range(117))
mismatches=[]
for i in range(117):
 a=json.loads((root/'id1-a'/f'state-{i:03d}.json').read_text());b=json.loads((root/'id31'/f'state-{i:03d}.json').read_text())
 diff=list(compare_state.differences(compare_state.canonical_initial_ids(a,1),compare_state.canonical_initial_ids(b,31)))
 if diff:mismatches.append(dict(index=i,paths=diff))
result=dict(run=40247679017,source_commit=report['source_commit'],artifact_id=12620176960,artifact_sha256='b8bc699e099ebd414598abada0b5c8e9014d710c00caeb429c275d77693a22b5',verified_snapshots=351,same_id_repeat_equal=True,sensitivity_mismatches=mismatches,cross_architecture_verified=False,full_schema_complete=False,m3_complete=False)
Path('/tmp/coh-resume/current-arm-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print('351 snapshot hashes/cursor/ACK/error validations pass; 117 same-ID snapshots match')
print('sensitivity:',[(m['index'],len(m['paths'])) for m in mismatches])
print('first mismatch paths:',mismatches[0]['paths'])
